paper_title: MobileNetV2: Inverted Residuals and Linear Bottlenecks
source: In this paper we describe a new mobile architecture, MobileNetV2, that improves the state of the art performance of mobile models on multiple tasks and benchmarks as well as across a spectrum of different model sizes. We also describe efficient ways of applying these mobile models to object detection in a novel framework we call SSDLite. claim: This architecture is reliable for clinical imaging because it works well across many mobile vision settings.
